name: views count as interest (the root cause)
from:
where x.user_id = (select uid from viewer) and x.first_interacted_at <= p_now
),
to:
where x.user_id = (select uid from viewer) and x.first_interacted_at <= p_now
  union all
  select p.topic, p.kind, least(v.seen_count, 3) from public.feed_views v
  join public.feed_posts p on p.id = v.post_id where v.user_id = (select uid from viewer)
),

name: no kind penalty
from: - least(8.0 * sqrt(row_number() over (partition by s.kind order by s.merit desc, s.id desc) - 1), 80)

name: seen by last sighting, even mid-reading
from: case when v.last_seen_at > p_now then coalesce(v.previous_seen_at, v.first_seen_at) else v.last_seen_at end seen_at

name: seen falls back to first sighting
from: coalesce(v.previous_seen_at, v.first_seen_at) else v.last_seen_at end seen_at

name: previous sighting not kept
views counted every time
from: from upserted u where f.id = u.post_id and u.inserted;
to: from upserted u where f.id = u.post_id;

name: hidden mid-reading drops out
from: and h.user_id = (select uid from viewer) and h.created_at <= p_now)

name: repeated interaction drops out
from: where x.user_id = (select uid from viewer) and x.first_interacted_at <= p_now
to: where x.user_id = (select uid from viewer) and x.last_interacted_at <= p_now

name: posts written mid-reading join it
from: and p.published_at <= p_now and p.created_at <= p_now

name: unpublished posts ranked
from: where p.status = 'published' and p.published_at <= p_now
to: where p.status in ('published', 'hidden') and p.published_at <= p_now

name: author may boost
from: new.boost := 0;

name: author may count
from: new.like_count := old.like_count;

name: author may date ahead
from: new.published_at := least(coalesce(new.published_at, now()), now());

name: author may backdate creation
from: new.created_at := now();

name: author may post as someone
from: new.author_key := 'profile:' || new.author_id;

name: author may self-verify
from: new.author_verified := coalesce(verified, false);

name: private jobs shared
from:
new.status::text = 'open' and new.visibility::text = 'public',
    'professional', 'community', new.poster_id

name: unlisted designs shared
from:
new.visibility::text = 'public' and new.published_at is not null,
    'ai_design'

name: digital floor plan filed as a document
from: k := case when digital and new.digital_kind::text = 'floor_plan' then 'floor_plan'::public.feed_kind
to: k := case when digital and new.digital_kind::text = 'floor_plan' then 'document'::public.feed_kind

name: samples not marked
from: update public.feed_posts set is_demo = new.is_sample

name: switch off ignored
from: select least((select w from total) / 15.0, 1.0) * case when (select personalised from pref) then 1 else 0 end c
to: select least((select w from total) / 15.0, 1.0) c

name: visitor ranking reads the table
from: select coalesce((select i.personalised from public.feed_viewer_preferences() i), true) personalised
to: select coalesce((select i.personalised from public.feed_interests i where i.user_id = (select uid from viewer)), true) personalised

name: featured unlimited
from: then least((row_number() over (partition by (s.boost > 0 and not s.is_demo) order by s.merit desc, s.id desc) - 1) * 12.0, 60)

name: samples labelled featured
from:
r.boost > 0 and not r.is_demo
from mixed r

name: visitor memory ignored
from:
select s.id, p_now from unnest(coalesce(p_seen_ids, '{}'::uuid[])) s(id)
  where (select uid from viewer) is null
to:
select s.id, p_now from unnest('{}'::uuid[]) s(id)
  where (select uid from viewer) is null

name: visitors may record views
from: revoke execute on function public.feed_record_views(uuid[], timestamptz) from public, anon;
to: grant execute on function public.feed_record_views(uuid[], timestamptz) to anon;

name: interests open to all
